description: A user's inspiration boards: videos they want to rewatch, pictures of what they are aiming at, links, notes. Import THIRTY-THIRD
notes: NOT the same thing as daily_content (23). That table is the rotating quote Habiti shows on the dashboard - content the app gives the user. This is content the user keeps.
board is TEXT holding either the literal 'personal' or a user_projects ROW id, exactly like project_id on user_tasks. Not a link_row, for the same reason: a link field cannot express 'personal'.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT holding String(user.id). EVERY read filters on it.

url holds the ORIGINAL address - a YouTube watch link, an image address, an article. Nothing is downloaded or re-hosted, so an item is a pointer, not a copy. If the far end disappears, so does the picture; that is the trade for not storing other people's media.

thumbnail_url for a YouTube item is https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg, built from source_id rather than fetched. Loading it means the user's browser talks to Google, which the app discloses on the board and in the privacy policy.
provider and source_id are stored so a thumbnail can be rebuilt if the format changes, without re-parsing every url.
An UPLOADED picture is an attachment (table 31), not an inspiration item - use kind 'image' with the returned media URL if it should also appear on a board.

title.description: What the user calls it. Primary field

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

url.description: The original address. http(s) only - checked in recogniseMedia()

source_id.description: The video id, where there is one

note.description: Why this is here. The whole point of a note-kind item

tags.description: Comma separated. Free text on purpose
